thesis: Biological regularities combine general mechanisms with contingent history and environment, never a moral verdict on worth.
role: Reject tautological and normative misuse of evolution.

ideas.statement: Selection concerns differential transmission in particular environments, including cooperation, not strength or moral progress.
Organisms and institutions modify conditions of advantage; natural processes do not mandate suffering or equate wealth with hereditary merit.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Hardy–Weinberg arithmetic becomes biological equilibrium only with biological assumptions.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Plausible evolutionary stories need independent evidence, and useful beliefs need not be completely true.
